name: Dynamic Toscana 3-Person Low EMF Far Infrared Sauna
description: Dynamic Toscana 3-Person Low EMF (Between 5-10 mg) Far Infrared Sauna (Canadian Hemlock) Dynamic Saunas are expertly crafted from eco-friendly Canadian Hemlock wood, known for its natural strength, durability, and beauty. Each sauna is equipped with advanced Low EMF FAR infrared heating panels that deliver gentle, energy-efficient heat to help reduce stress, soothe muscles, and restore balance to the body. With a sleek design and premium materials, these saunas bring the luxury of a spa experience directly into your home while supporting your overall wellness. Designed for convenience and versatility, Dynamic Saunas can be installed in almost any indoor space, whether it’s a basement, master bathroom, walk-in closet, or home fitness room. Their compact yet stylish construction allows them to blend effortlessly into your living environment while offering long-lasting relaxation and health benefits. With easy installation and low energy consumption, a Dynamic Sauna is the perfect way to elevate your home and create a daily escape for mind and body. Features: Full 3-person capacity Low EMF - EMF between 5-10 mg 2 to 3 inches from the heating panels Natural Canadian Reforested Hemlock wood construction Easy Removable Bench - Stretching, Exercise, or Yoga Tempered glass door Interior chromotherapy lighting system with red light feature 8 Low EMF 360 Carbon Heat Emitters (Heating Panels) - (Heating Panels on all 4 interior walls.) Roof vent Interior LED Control Panel Bluetooth, MP3 auxiliary connection with built in speakers Clasp together assembly Ships in 3 boxes Specifications: Sauna weight: 385 lbs. Shipping weight: 485 lbs. Electrical service: 110V/20amp dedicated receptacle (consult a certified electrician) Exterior dimensions (LWH): 42" x 60" x 75" Interior dimensions (LWH): 38" x 56" x 68" Document: View Owner's Manual
